a.lede: A jury has found Huawei guilty of stealing US trade secrets, as reported earlier by NBC News and Bloomberg. The verdict, handed down in a federal court in New York, concludes a years-long legal battle that accused the Chinese telecom giant of stealing source code and proprietary technology from several companies, including T-Mobile, Cisco, and […]
a.title: Huawei found guilty of stealing trade secrets

b.lede: A jury found Huawei guilty on 10 out of 12 counts, although it was acquitted of racketeering and conspiracy to obstruct justice.
b.title: Huawei convicted of money laundering, conspiracy to steal trade secrets, and fraud by US jury
